text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx rate detected from gateway -> inference runtime (502/504 spike). Autoscaler reports increased latency. Triggering pager for oncall.

dave-oncall: I'm on it. Can you post current error rates and affected routes?

incident-bot: 5xx rate up 22% over baseline in last 3m. Top affected route: /v1/generate (quant-optimized models). Errors are 502 gateway / 504 upstream timeouts.

alice-sre: Seeing repeated kernel OOMs on several inference nodes (gpu-pool-12). dmesg shows repeated "oom_kill_process" around the same time as 5xx spike.

carla-ml: Which model variant is hot? Metrics show heavy tail requests to model: rdw-infer/bison-q4_0 (quantized). Long context requests (~8k tokens) are common in the failing traces.

frank-eng: We recently enabled the quant kernel path for that model in the autoscaling config. Suspect quant kernel memory regression on long sequences.

erin-support: Customer-impact: a handful of PLG customers reported timeouts in the last 10m. CS notes 3 incidents opened, severity moderate. pinging luis-cs for more.

luis-cs: Confirmed — 3 customers affected: two saw intermittent timeouts, one saw sustained errors for 2m then degraded to increased latency. All using hosted API in region-us-west.

dave-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Remove quant kernel path for bison-q4_0 via runtime feature-flag rollback. 2) Reroute new requests to bison-fp16 fallback. 3) Scale up non-quant pool and disable batching for that model temporarily. 4) Drain and reboot OOM nodes. Who can flip flags + trigger reroute?

frank-eng: I can flip the feature flag and push a routing override. Patching now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by frank-eng: feature-flag/quant-path-disabled for rdw-infer/bison-q4_0 -> started.

frank-eng: feature flag flipped, routing override applied to route traffic to bison-fp16. Also set max_batch_size=1 for that route.

alice-sre: Starting rolling drain of gpu-pool-12 nodes (3 nodes). Will reboot and keep in quarantine until mem profiles clear.

incident-bot: Router update: 92% of /v1/generate traffic now hitting bison-fp16, 8% still to old route (in-flight). 5xx rate dropping.

erin-support: Customers notified via status page update. I'll follow up with CS to confirm recovery messages to affected customers.

carla-ml: Looking at KV cache growth: quant path was causing huge KV allocations on long sequences, and combined with the new kernel's mem accounting it triggered OOM. That explains the correlation. We'll add a regression test for long-context quant workloads.

dave-oncall: Post-mitigation: 5xx rate back to baseline after routing change and node reboots. Logging traces collected and saved to /mnt/incidents/4801237890/traces.tar.gz.

alice-sre: Quarantined nodes show memory leak signature in nvml; collecting full heap traces and coredumps. Uploading to infra bucket now.

frank-eng: Opening follow-up ticket for kernel patch + regression tests: INF-4521. Also schedule a canary rollout with tighter limits before re-enabling quant path.

luis-cs: Customers confirmed recovery. Two want post-incident report; escalate to success + account teams.

dave-oncall: Handoff: I'll update the incident channel with timeline and assign INF-4521 to frank-eng and carla-ml. Also will loop in security for coredump retention policy.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> status: mitigated. Postmortem requested within 48h.

frank-eng: Quick notes for postmortem: repro steps, nvml logs, quant kernel commit range, traffic patterns. Will attach PRs and tests.

erin-support: Thanks team. I'll coordinate customer communications and mark support tickets as addressed. :thumbsup:

alice-sre: Leaving nodes quarantined until root-cause triage complete. Will share timeline in the postmortem.

carla-ml: Action items: (1) Regression test for long contexts + quant kernels, (2) Canary rollout policy change, (3) Improve alerting to correlate OOM + route error spikes.

dave-oncall: Good work. Closing live channel; follow-up doc & postmortem in #postmortems when ready.
